name: Collision3D
description: Light 3D collision in C: static triangles of level meshes, glTF scenes and boxes in a bounding volume hierarchy, raycasts, sphere casts and overlaps with layers, and kinematic characters (an upright ellipsoid) that walk with collide-and-slide: gravity, walkable slopes, steps, ground snapping, no tunneling, driving a Scene3D node from one Loop system.
